observed_runtime.vision_source_precision: AMP FP16 with TF32 enabled by original train.py; not FP32 re-adaptation timing

vision_test_history_audit.interpretation: No test scoring/selection found in retained relevant runs; test files were downloaded and their Dataset object was constructed. This is not proof of all unrecorded use.

language.test_role: post-hoc audit of the already scored fixed official test; not new independent confirmation

stop_policy.technical_failure: Stop affected branch and repair only an identified implementation or resource issue; preserve diagnostics and the same declared configuration.
stop_policy.numerical_instability: Abort the affected trajectory; if intrinsic to the declared optimizer configuration, retain it as a failed candidate, not a reason to resample seeds.
stop_policy.screen_eligibility: Both screening seeds finite at 512 updates for that T and lr.
stop_policy.no_eligible_lr: Stop that branch and report failure inside the fixed grid; do not expand automatically.
stop_policy.formal_seed_failure: Report incomplete pairs and failure reasons; no replacement seeds and no test-driven lr changes.
stop_policy.scientific_outcome: All signed or null findings retained; completion does not require a favorable direction.
stop_policy.completion: Stop when the fixed queue reaches recorded terminal states; no automatic scope expansion.

required_new_entrypoints: separate adaptation_T and inference_T scorer with fixed last-batch policy and full graph scoring
